Mobility / Transfer Status: Max assist for bed mobility; mechanical lift for transfers.

Wound / Skin Needs: Small coccyx wound, foam dressing.
Oxygen / Respiratory Needs: Tracheostomy collar at 28%; frequent suctioning.
Dialysis Need: No dialysis.
Cognitive Status: Follows simple commands.
Behavioral / Safety Concerns: No aggression.
Infection / Isolation Status: No isolation required.
Advance Directive / Code Status: Full code.
Durable Medical Equipment Needs: Tracheostomy supplies, suction equipment, tube-feed pump.
